critic.fix_suggestion: Instantiate a series of 20 small rectangular planes along the fuselage side. Each plane should have dimensions of 0.5 units (width) by 0.3 units (height), spaced at 1.5-unit intervals starting from the cockpit rear to the tail. Orient each plane perpendicular to the fuselage surface and offset them slightly inward by 0.05 units to simulate recessed window frames.
